individual-data-points.explanation: Bar chart of mean cell death (%) across three independent experiments; only mean+/-SD bars are shown, no individual data points from the three experiments are overlaid.
Bar chart of cell death (%) with error bars indicating replicate variability, but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
Grouped bar chart of mean cell death (%) at several time points from three experiments; only mean+/-SD is shown, individual data points are not displayed.
Bar chart of cell death (%) with error bars, but individual data points behind the means are not shown.

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Mean±s.d. of three independent experiments is reported.
error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: PASS - caption explicitly states error bars represent mean +/- SD of three independent experiments.
FAIL - the bar chart shows error bars but the caption text for panel B does not state what they represent (no mean/SD/SEM statement given for this panel).

error-bars-defined.from_the_caption: Mean±s.d. of three experiments is reported.
error-bars-defined.Decision_and_explanation: PASS - caption explicitly states error bars represent mean +/- SD of three experiments.
